name: Damage Inc.
caption: An established tag team booked as the third side of a three-way elimination dream tag match on a card called off before it was held.

tenures.source: Billed for the second night on the event's own lineup of 2 June 2002; the event was called off before it was held.

identity.note: Shares its billed name with wrestlers held in other promotions; no roster, operator or document ties this supercard billing to any of them.
